# change fabric, the hero's journey

## Hypotheses

- H-01 (role): A newcomer can say what Change Fabric is (a layer on the agent they already use) and whether it is for them after one viewing.
- H-02 (look_and_feel): Scenes that follow the homepage's headings and order (the problem, Is it for me?, What is it?, Before it merges, Start building) make the page and the clip read as one story.

## 5. Before it merges (`gate`)

- Duration: 12000 ms
- Screen: screens/gate.html
- User goal: See what the gate checks and what fails it
- Action: Watch a change ride each of the five checks into the CHANGE.md gate
- Hypotheses: H-01, H-02
- Heuristics shown: H1, H9
- Requirement: brief.md#gate
- Assumption A-03: The run on screen is illustrative; each result names what fails that check, not a real finding.
- Lane `load`: Load [gauge]
- Lane `a11y`: Accessibility [wheelchair]
- Lane `security`: Security [shield-check]
- Lane `ux`: Responsive [devices]
- Lane `cases`: Test cases [test-tube]
- Node `check-load`: k6 (pinned) (lane load)
- Node `check-a11y`: axe-core (pinned) (lane a11y)
- Node `check-security`: OWASP ZAP (pinned) (lane security)
- Node `check-ux`: browserless (pinned) (lane ux)
- Node `check-cases`: testcases (pinned) (lane cases)
- Node `pr`: Your change [git-pull-request] (pinned)
- Node `r-load`: Threshold breaks
- Node `r-a11y`: Serious impact
- Node `r-security`: Bad headers
- Node `r-ux`: Layout breaks
- Node `r-cases`: A case fails
- Initial: check-load, check-a11y, check-security, check-ux, check-cases
